Your coach

Talk to it like a real trainer.

Hold the button and speak, or type. FAiT logs your meals, sets, and weigh-ins straight from the conversation, then gives you a straight answer about what to do next.

  • Remembers your goals, injuries, and what you hate doing
  • Four coaching styles, from calm mentor to no-excuses drill coach
  • Flags when you're under-eating or over-reaching
Every morning

Know exactly what today needs.

Your dashboard reads your numbers and turns them into a short plan: the one gap that matters most, how much protein is left, and how many steps to go.

  • Daily grade so you know where you stand at a glance
  • Quick check-in for energy, sleep, soreness, and stress
  • Coach adjusts the plan to how you actually feel
Nutrition

Say what you ate. That's it.

No food database rabbit holes. Voice log your meal, snap a photo, or scan a barcode. FAiT works out the calories and macros for you.

  • Calorie and macro targets built for your goal
  • Protein, carbs, and fat tracked live through the day
  • Fasting timer for 16:8 and other windows
Workouts

Plans built around you.

Pick a plan your coach recommends or build your own from scratch. Save the ones you like and load them in one tap next time.

  • Push, pull, legs, and full-body plans with time and calorie estimates
  • Swap or refresh exercises when equipment is taken
  • Saved workout templates for your regular routine
Progress

See it add up.

Weekly workouts, volume, streaks, and calorie deficit in one place. Watch your weight trend toward your goal and your lifts climb week over week.

  • Body weight chart with your goal line
  • Strength progress by exercise
  • Guided progress photos so every shot lines up
